StyleStack

Your wardrobe, intelligently styled. StyleStack turns the clothes you own into daily outfit ideas, tailored to your taste, the weather, and your plans.

An AI-powered digital wardrobe with personalized outfit recommendations, a mix-and-match Style Canvas, and outfit planning. Optional calendar and Gmail integrations help connect your wardrobe with your day.
